Every course is built around the exam it prepares for, so the lessons, the practice questions and the mock tests all follow the same syllabus, in the same order, with nothing left to chance and nothing you will not need.

I studied on the train every morning and passed on the first try, which I never expected to do.

The short lectures fit into my lunch break, and the practice questions showed me what to review next.

Tracking my score every week kept me going through the months before the exam day arrived.

I could replay the hard parts at double speed and skip what I already knew well enough.

The mock exams felt like the real one, so nothing on the day came as a surprise to me.

Every chapter ended with a short test, and the results told me exactly where to spend my evenings.

I kept my notes in the app and read them again on the way to the exam hall that morning.
